ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the recent court fight over Medicaid funding in Minnesota and potential fraud in the program
ideas.angle: Follow the money trail to identify potential perpetrators and determine the extent of the fraud
questions: What is the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose a large-scale fraud scheme and bring perpetrators to justice. By following the money trail, we can identify potential perpetrators and determine the extent of the fraud.
